summary: Loads customer records and raw events, turns them into recency/frequency features, trains a gradient-boosting churn model, and writes per-customer churn scores only if the test AUC clears the configured bar.

n1.summary: File locations and the random seed shared by several steps.

n2.summary: Name of the target column used when splitting and scoring.

n3.summary: Reads config.json: customer file, as-of date, test size, model params, AUC bar.

n4.summary: Reads raw events and caches them to the staging parquet; returns only the row count.

n5.summary: Loads the customer table named in the config.

n6.summary: Joins customers with staged events to compute recency and frequency per customer.

n7.summary: Separates the label and makes a seeded train/test split.

n8.summary: Fits a GradientBoostingClassifier with the configured parameters.

n9.summary: Scores the test set and returns ROC AUC.

n10.summary: Logs the event count and AUC.

n11.summary: If AUC passes the bar, scores every customer and writes scores.csv.

h12.summary: Day difference between two date series.

implicit_edges.label: staging.parquet
implicit_edges.reason: ingest_events writes STAGING_PATH; build_features reads it back. The only link between them is the file, so ingest must run first.
